subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Kevin bought shoes that made a squeaking sound on the school floor.”?
options: Two students he did not know stopped to help.
Students stopped walking through the garden.
Later, other students shared their family foods too.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Two students he did not know stopped to help.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Other students stopped caring.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Students stopped walking through the garden.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
